persistence_contract.qt_window_preference: home_dashboard_overhaul/settings_dialog_geometry/v4 logical geometry screen identity available bounds and informational DPR with valid v3 migration
persistence_contract.settings_preview: none; preview widgets swatches and heatmap preview cards are prohibited

acceptance_criteria.requirement: Settings uses a fixed 72 px header, one native active-page body scroller with no horizontal range, and a fixed 60 px footer beside a 184 px vertical rail; compact top navigation is restricted to the small-screen fallback, with no embedded WebEngine content.

The resizable window defaults to 1080x760 logical px, enforces an 820x600 normal minimum, uses 48 px normal and 24 px constrained-screen margins, migrates only valid at-least-80-percent-visible v3 geometry into logical v4 geometry with screen identity and available bounds, centers a maximum-1120 shell and maximum-920 page, and retains the parented standard QDialog exec lifecycle.
All four complete decorated windows are captured at 1080x760, 1280x800, and full screen at exactly 100 percent application font. No 720 940 or 150 percent page frames belong to the Settings profile.

Accurate dirty count, Discard changes, Close, Save changes, Saving, two-second Saved, validation, and generic persistence failure feedback remain local to the fixed footer; failure retains staged values and leaves Save enabled.

Events proves bounded empty, populated, editor-open, searched, no-results, archived, and long-title states with a labeled sort control, complete selected-tab search, one context-appropriate Add event CTA, and no persistent row selection.

Bible proves short, long, valid custom, invalid custom, and long-row states with no rendered preview, equal-width color-source segments, one inline validation error, a complete filtered verse model, clamped two-line excerpts, and no unexplained result cap.

About proves Version and support, Privacy and legal, and Backup and recovery cards, manifest-derived Supports Anki Desktop 26.8 wording, local diagnostics feedback, byte-exact Scripture attribution, and complete recovery content.

Dirty, discard, child close confirmation, saving, successful save, production-formatted failure, clean legacy Calendar routing, fresh-open and clamped geometry, timer-free page switching, and controlled restart are proven; legacy geometry, monitor, and compact fallback remain structured assertions, while exact-package macOS full-screen opening from both menu and Dashboard gear must pass without a desktop or Space switch in a required structured manual result rather than extra PNGs.
Application-relative role fonts remain at least 12 px at the 100 percent baseline, controls use 36 px targets, and alternate-font captures are explicitly outside this minimal profile.
The transparent root remains in normal flow at max 1120 px with 24 px top and 20 px side minimums and no root viewport-height or overflow clipping.

A visible fixed or sticky bottom-action container is detected without localized button text and drives root padding and document scroll padding by measured height plus 24 px; 60 px is fallback height only.
Month and Year reuse one 24 px title and compact 34 px control header that wraps naturally without hiding controls.
Month always renders a 42-cell six-week grid and retains independently visible completion, selection, today, due, and event cues.

Year keeps one real 53-week tree with fluid week columns, compacts its 28 px label column and 3 px gaps below 760 px, has no horizontal scrolling at 480 px and above, and confines any sub-480 px overflow to the heatmap.
Legend and date/event summary are compact and conditional while browsing, editing, adding, tooltips, date selection, and Most Missed remain intact.
Every theme-specific saved palette ID has separately authored and visually distinct light and dark completion ladders while IDs and selections stay unchanged.
White, black, purple, and image hosts preserve Anki chrome and remain legible without repainting the host.
Production renders the configured verse font, size, and color exactly across responsive layouts.
Schema remains 8 and name sorting is case-insensitive by name, then date and stable ID; ascending and descending retain date semantics.

Today's Progress is collection-wide minus dashboard deck exclusions, sums independently limited top-level due-tree heads, classifies queues 0 as New, 1/3/4 as Learning, and 2 as Review regardless of card type, excludes queues -1/-2/-3, remains independent of the selected deck, and enforces Total remaining = New + Learning + Reviews.

Today's Session uses exactly [next rollover - 86400 seconds, next rollover), counts distinct qualifying introductions, counts only explicitly buried cards that are New or currently due/overdue, calculates seconds per answer, and retains the whole-minute-ceiling ETA policy.
Last 7 Days and All Time match Anki 26.8.1 true-retention eligibility, display one half-up whole percentage, and display Again as its exact visible complement.

Calendar history and selected-day details use the same rollover-relative records, while due forecasting matches Anki's non-new, non-suspended future-due logic including original filtered-deck due dates and future buried cards but excluding buried work due today.
Initial HTML, live refresh, wide Month and Year 2x2 layouts, intermediate and narrow layouts, and restart all expose identical metric values from one canonical snapshot.

Config and manual verse writes are prepared before mutation, previous config and bytes are retained, and a partial failure attempts rollback before a generic user-facing footer error with separately disclosed technical detail.
The reproducible 1.8.7 archive passes its allowlist, safe-path, byte-parity, manifest/assets, secret/link, and exact-installed-hash gates.
Fresh and restarted Anki 26.8 runs prove process, window, filesystem, and sync isolation before interaction.
Identical package and capture-plan hashes are required across native Windows 100/125/150 percent, Linux 100/150 percent, DPR 1, and macOS Retina bundles; any missing bundle is release-blocking.
VoiceOver and forced colors may remain explicitly unrun and nonblocking; no report implies that either surface was tested.
